newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly dip $2 but fuel is steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly dip $2 but fuel is steady.

text.p: NWE oil products mostly slipped in early trading on Wednesday, tracking weaker crude.
Gasoline eased $2 a tonne with early trade at $204 and $202 on barges. Swaps also slipped to around $203 for June and some $6 lower for July.
Gas oil eased $2 a tonne on the IPE but premiums for barges held steady at $1.25 a tonne above the screen, little changed from Tuesday.
Despite losses on other products, heavy fuel barges were unchanged. "We haven't seen any Russian cargoes on offer and barges are well bid at $83," said a trader.
Only one offer was heard at 484 for loading up to 9 June.
